text: そりゃ　たたかって　みなけりゃ　おしえんよ！

structure.jp: たたかって　みなけりゃ

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: たたかって　みなけりゃ
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-verb means 'try doing it and see'. たたかって　みる = 'try battling'.

patterns.name: 〜なければ
patterns.explanation: なければ means 'if not' or 'unless'. なけりゃ is the squeezed, spoken form. たたかって　みなけりゃ = 'unless you try battling'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん in place of ない is a rough, older-man way of saying 'not'. おしえん = おしえない = 'I won't tell'.
